name: Command Center
purpose: Give the user a trusted answer to what matters now.
components: Global search and command button | Active deployments cards | Today timeline and route | Urgent commitments | Interview/outreach queue | Unverified high-priority claims | Assets awaiting ingest or metadata | Capture packages incomplete | Outputs in production | Sync/job health | Quick capture rail
actions: Open deployment | Complete or snooze task | Start Field Mode | Create any record | Run targeted sync | Review alert
states: Empty first-run | Normal | Offline with cached data | Integration degraded | Sensitive item hidden by role
mobile_behavior: Cards collapse into Today, Next Interview, Capture, and Alerts. Quick Capture remains fixed at bottom.
acceptance: Loads actionable content in under 2 seconds on normal connection | Every alert links to its cause and resolution action | No count is displayed without queryable underlying records

name: Deployments index
purpose: Compare and enter all field deployments.
components: Status tabs | Calendar/timeline | Map | Deployment cards | Readiness score | Upcoming dates | Filter by city, outlet, lane and status
actions: Create deployment | Duplicate structure | Archive deployment | Open planning or field workspace
states: Planning | Ready | Active | Processing | Closed | Cancelled
mobile_behavior: List view sorted by proximity; map optional.
acceptance: Manhattan and Reykjavík appear with dates, mission, next action and Drive status | Archived deployments remain searchable

name: Deployment workspace
purpose: Operate one trip from planning through outputs.
components: Mission and assignments | Readiness meter | Dates, city, timezone, credentials and Drive link | Targets | Schedule/route | Interview pipeline | Research questions | Claims/law/evidence | Shot lists and capture packages | Daily logs | Assets | Outputs | Follow-ups | Notion mirror status
actions: Add target | Send/create outreach draft | Book interaction | Start Field Mode | Create daily plan | Run completeness audit | Close deployment
states: Planning | Field active | Post-field processing | Closed; immutable summary with continuing follow-ups
mobile_behavior: Defaults to Today tab during active dates; offline cache includes itinerary, contacts, consent and capture cards.
acceptance: A user can reach any deployment record within two taps | Readiness identifies exact missing prerequisites | Closing requires unresolved promises and restrictions review

name: Today / Field plan
purpose: Translate the deployment into a chronological, location-aware action plan.
components: Timeline | Map/route | Travel buffers | Access requirements | Interview cards | Capture package state | Evidence requests | Weather/manual notes | Emergency contacts | Offline status
actions: Check in | Start capture | Record delay | Reorder | Skip with reason | Open navigation | Add spontaneous interaction
states: On time | At risk | Delayed | Skipped | Completed
mobile_behavior: Large tap targets; minimal text; high contrast; one-hand use.
acceptance: Changes persist offline and sync without duplicate actions | Skipped priority-A item requires reason and recovery task

name: Target / relationship record
purpose: Preserve who the source is, why they matter, and every relationship context.
components: Identity and pronunciation | Roles and organizations over time | Expertise and interests | Contact routes | Relationship history | Deployments and interactions | Claims/evidence | Permissions/preferences | Introductions | Commitments | Potential outputs | Risk/conflict disclosures
actions: Create outreach | Schedule interview | Request introduction | Add note | Link to claim/system/output | Restrict identity
states: Prospect | Contacted | Active source | Research participant | Collaborator | Dormant | Do not contact
mobile_behavior: Compact identity, next action, contact, and last interaction first.
acceptance: No duplicate person is created when email or external IDs match | Restricted identity is omitted from unauthorized search and exports

name: Interaction / interview workspace
purpose: Prepare, conduct, and close a source interaction.
components: Context and role | Participants | Purpose | Question tree | Ground rules | Consent recorder | Recording files | Live notes | Promises | Claims detected | Evidence requested | Cognition update | Follow-up
actions: Begin consent | Start/stop interview timer | Mark on/off record segment | Add timestamped note | Capture claim | Close interaction
states: Draft | Scheduled | In progress | Processing | Completed | Restricted | Cancelled
mobile_behavior: Interview Mode hides unrelated app elements and prevents accidental navigation.
acceptance: Consent state is visible continuously during recording | Off-record segments are timestamped and excluded from default transcript retrieval | Closing prompts for promises, next source and immediate cognition update

name: Claim record
purpose: Represent one exact assertion independently from its support.
components: Exact wording | Claimant/context/time | Type | Stakeholders/consequences | Evidence links | Counterevidence | Conflicts | Legal significance | Financial interest | Verification history | Permitted outputs
actions: Add evidence | Request response | Change status with reason | Create contradiction | Generate verification brief
states: Unreviewed | Unverified | Partially verified | Verified | Disputed | False | Superseded | Do not use
mobile_behavior: Quick capture stores exact wording and context first; detailed fields later.
acceptance: Every status change is audited | Verified status requires at least one evidence record and reviewer/owner action | AI cannot set final status

name: Evidence / law record
purpose: Store and evaluate the source supporting or challenging claims.
components: Source identity | Evidence type | Original file/URL | Date/version/jurisdiction | Method/population/comparator/metric | Reliability/fitness | Limitations | Claims supported/challenged | Legal authority/citation | Verification notes | Drive location
actions: Attach/copy to Drive | Extract text | Link claim | Add limitation | Create superseding version
states: Unreviewed | Authenticated | Method reviewed | Verified for stated purpose | Disputed | Superseded | Restricted
mobile_behavior: Capture URL/photo/document now; detailed evaluation can be queued.
acceptance: Source version is preserved | A later version does not overwrite the historical source | Legal records store effective dates and temporal status

name: Systems reconstruction
purpose: Make the actual workflow, authority and consequence visible.
components: System summary | Trigger | Actors/institutions | Step graph | Inputs/outputs | Decision rules | Law | Evidence/assets | Exceptions | Feedback | Failure and repair | Affected people | Version comparison
actions: Add step | Connect nodes | Mark observed/claimed | Create exception | Compare jurisdiction/time | Export map
states: Draft | Partially observed | Verified | Disputed | Superseded
mobile_behavior: Field capture supports adding a step or friction point with voice and photo.
acceptance: Every graph edge has a source status | Observed and claimed steps render differently | Export can include evidence citations and uncertainty legend

name: Media ingest
purpose: Protect and convert raw field media into searchable records.
components: Device/session selector | File manifest | Duplicate detection | Destination Drive folder | Naming preview | Metadata defaults | Consent/restriction inheritance | Checksum/status | Proxy/transcript queue | Errors
actions: Scan files | Assign subject | Create Drive folders | Copy/upload | Verify | Queue transcription | Quarantine
states: Pending | Copying | Verifying | Protected | Processing | Needs review | Failed
mobile_behavior: Mobile supports registering a file and uploading small urgent audio; large media typically ingests from desktop.
acceptance: Source files are not deleted by the application | A file is protected only after two verified copies or explicit override | Partial failure is resumable

name: Asset record
purpose: Preserve provenance, permissions, context and potential uses for one media/document asset.
components: Preview/proxy | Master location | Capture metadata | People/place/system/claim links | Consent and restrictions | Transcript | Derivative lineage | Verification | Potential outputs | Usage history
actions: Edit metadata | Create derivative | Restrict | Link records | Export source card | Request permission
states: Unreviewed | Protected | Metadata complete | Restricted | Approved for specified uses | Published | Do not use
mobile_behavior: Quick asset card emphasizes restriction and context; proxy-only playback.
acceptance: Original master is immutable in app | Derivatives identify parent asset and edit method | Permission changes flag affected outputs

name: Universal search and research canvas
purpose: Retrieve across structured, textual, graph, geographic and multimodal records.
components: Natural language box | Filters | Result groups | Why this matched | Source excerpts | Graph neighborhood | Map/timeline | Saved query | Research canvas
actions: Open source | Pin to canvas | Compare | Create brief | Export source set | Convert question to research task
states: Keyword | Semantic | Hybrid | Graph neighborhood | Exact citation
mobile_behavior: Recent searches and voice query; no automatic sensitive result preview.
acceptance: Every generated answer cites internal record IDs | Search respects permissions before retrieval | User can inspect query filters and source set

name: Output workspace
purpose: Turn evidence into a controlled publication or media object.
components: Brief and audience | Assignment/outlet | Source set | Claims allowed | Asset selects | Structure | Draft/script | Rights and permissions | Fact check | Legal/editorial review | Versions | Publication/correction
actions: Assemble source packet | Generate outline | Draft from approved sources | Request permission | Approve version | Publish/archive | Issue correction
states: Idea | Assigned | Researching | Drafting | Review | Ready | Published | Corrected | Killed
mobile_behavior: Mobile permits review and notes, not final publication by default.
acceptance: Generated text cannot cite restricted/off-record material | Publication readiness blocks on unresolved permissions and high-risk unverified claims | Corrections preserve prior version and reason

name: FCIF Library
purpose: Keep the method, standards, fieldbooks and capture cards inside the operational product.
components: Manual sections | Standards | Capture taxonomy | Consent cards | Domain fieldbooks | Version history | Linked implementation templates
actions: Read | Search | Apply template | Propose revision | View superseded rule
mobile_behavior: Offline cache of active field cards and consent language.
acceptance: Every operational template identifies its governing standard version | Changing a standard creates a migration/review notice rather than silently changing historical records

name: Settings and integrations
purpose: Administer the workspace without exposing secrets or complexity during field use.
components: Profile/workspace | Roles | Notion connection | Drive connection | AI/transcription providers | Controlled vocabularies | Retention | Exports | Audit log | Sync conflicts | Feature flags
actions: Connect/revoke | Test | Run sync | Rotate secret | Export | Restore | Invite role
acceptance: Secrets never render after entry | Revoking an integration stops future jobs without deleting canonical records | Sync conflict requires explicit resolution
